name: Tarkan
note: The world's manifest (docs/plans/order-plan.md, sprint D). `show` is MapShow, read by game/world/world_show.cpp: what the client draws, plays and hears here. A system opens only where its field is set. Copied to assets/world/<w>/world.json by pipeline/sync.sh.

rules.note: Tarkan, MU's map 8, entered from Atlans's south-west lagoon: its spawn gate 57, 187,54 to 203,69, the safe town in the north-east (WebZen's gate.txt 57; docs/worlds/tarkan-port.md), where a death and the Town Portal land too. 195,65 rather than the box's middle: 195,61 is a closed statue block. Not 0.75's: MU added it with patch 0.84. MU draws it on its black clear with no leaves and no wind (MainScene.cpp:78-100), so for now it takes the underground's air. Loch's Feather falls here (sim/items.h featherMap; Blood Castle 6 too, which the castle asks itself): the user, 2026-10-09, 'feather is late game item, tarkan, icarus, bc6'. The Scroll of Nova falls here (sim/items.h novaScrollMap): a kill of level 60 or over, one in 1500 (the user, 2026-10-07: 'Scroll of Nova drop'; 'Scroll of Nova should drop also in tarkan'). Ours: MU's comes off Kanturu's bags. The second class's gear falls in its ordinary pools (the user, 2026-10-04: 'there will be tarkan map where 2nd class drop'). Ours.

air.note: desert.wav over the whole map, open desert under the sky.

weather.note: Devias's blizzard's shape, never stopping and never full (the user, 2026-10-05).

indoors.note: No open sky on any tile (MU draws it on its black clear, SceneManager.cpp:402).

crawls.note: MoveFishs' WD_8TARKAN arm, MODEL_BUG01 + 1 (GOBoid.cpp:1726-1733); drawn at 0.55 (the user, 2026-10-05: 'make thos bugs smaller').

void_clouds.note: A warm sand-dust grey (the user, 2026-10-05: 'also use BC clouds in voids'), 2.4 times the castle's light; its top layer alone, over the wide voids (the user, 2026-10-06).

haze.note: MU's (0.3, 0.3, 0.25) at 0.4 of it: the storm a trace rather than a veil (the user, 2026-10-05: 'redcue dust screen effect little bit').

npcs.name: Baz The Vault Keeper
npcs.note: The repack's Baz and Amy (WZD MonsterSetBase.txt:37-38), as Atlans has them, at its tiles in the safe hall, facing the camera (the user, 2026-10-06: 'add missing npc in tarkan'). Its Thompson (231 at 191,74) is left out, as he was taken off Devias.

npcs.name: Keeper Aurel
npcs.note: Ours: the Keeper of Kantur (content/npc/NpcSenatus.json, MU's Senior), whom Lirien's 'The Road of Kantur' sends the hero to meet (docs/game/tarkan-quest.md; the user, 2026-10-06: 'lets use sonatus as keeper in Tarkan'). Past the arrival tile, facing the camera as Lirien does; content/world/tarkan/placements.json says why. 701 is ours, no MU NPC's.

exits.note: Tarkan's and Atlans's, WebZen's gate.txt 54, 56 and 57 (Season Six Gates.cs:200, 194, 198; docs/worlds/tarkan-port.md A §2.1). 54 is Direction.North (7), (-1,+1), into Tarkan's safe corridor and away from gate 55 beside it; 56 is Direction.South (3), (+1,-1), into Atlans's south-west lagoon and away from gate 53; 57 is the spawn gate, the town, WebZen's box (Season Six's starts at row 63), with no direction: a death and the Town Portal land there. Tarkan, from Atlans
Tarkan, from Kanturu: the tiles inside the arch (Gates.cs:201), facing east, away from door 125 beside it.

enters.note: Tarkan to Kanturu, through the arch on the west edge (Object86-88 at 4.5,199.6). OpenMU VersionSeasonSix Gates.cs:537; MU asks 150, ours 320, just above Aida's 300 (docs/worlds/kanturu-port.md decision 4; the user, 2026-10-22: next).

spawn.note: OpenMU's spawn gate 57: the box a new character starts in and a dead one stands up in, the .mur's safe gate (pipeline/index.py gate_rows). rules.arrive is its middle. Out of mu.db's gates table in sprint D6.

hidden.note: Tarkan's six (RenderObjectVisual, ZzzObject.cpp:2994-3065): 60 the dust burst, 82 of them, hidden after its first puff; 63 the cyan glow sprite, 18, and 64 its red twin, which nothing places; 70, 76 and 83 the smoke vents and sand geysers, 3, 19 and 10. All emitters, drawn by no mesh. docs/worlds/tarkan-port.md.

blend_mesh.note: Tarkan's (MoveObject, ZzzObject.cpp:4087-4179): the cyan ring, the white pulse, the 98 lava glows, the sun-gear and forge gears, the red lava flow and the light shafts. docs/worlds/tarkan-port.md.

grass.note: Tarkan ships TileGrass01.OZT, a strip of dry straw blades, and MU grows it on slot 0 (ZzzLodTerrain.cpp:2077-2120): the north-east town, as the rest of slot 0 is NoGround. TileGrass03.OZT is empty and no tile wears slot 2. docs/worlds/tarkan-port.md.

void.note: Tarkan: Devias's way (the user, 2026-10-05: 'we need similiar tehniq which we used on devias to blend deep clifs with void'), MU's cut with the cliff walls hanging into the dark, but its walls are Object41's 3.7 m faces sunk about 3.5 m, not Devias's 7.8 m ice: at the default 1.5 m to 6.5 m they ended lit. From 0.3 m under the rim, black by 3.3 m.

perches.note: Tarkan: MOVEMENT_OPERATE's WD_8TARKAN arm, `case 78: Sit = true` with no turn (ZzzInterface.cpp:1743-1748); CreateOperate (ZzzObject.cpp:4778-4786). The 13 stumps, at 39-44,53-56 and in the town. docs/worlds/tarkan-port.md.

grounded_types.note: Tarkan's plants: the dry tufts (6), creepers (15, 16), thorn and fern bushes (17-19), cacti (20, 21, 24, 25), grass clump (22), ferns (26, 30) and star plants (53). MU perches 71 of them on rocks, trees and cliff tops, up to 3 m over the ground, and here they read as hanging in the air (the user, 2026-10-05: 'there is some flaoting grass objects'). Ours: laid on the terrain, where one beside a rock tucks into its foot. And the rags (8, Object09), which MU hangs 2-3 m up in the open with nothing to hang from (the user's shot at 90,71): laid down, they flap on the sand as blown cloth.

anchor_kinds.note: Tarkan's hidden emitters (RenderObjectVisual's WD_8TARKAN arm, ZzzObject.cpp:2994-3065), drawn by game/world/desert_vents.h: 7 the falling sand of Object71, 8 the steam vents of Object77, 9 the sand geysers of Object84, 10 the cyan glow sprites of Object64. None lights. 11 Object61's standing dust clouds (SubType 6, which never dies). And Object05, whose .bmd the client does not ship, but whose MoveObject arm still adds its white pulsing terrain light (ZzzObject.cpp:4095-4106): a lamp, 0.
